notes.title: Devlog 2.8
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787231/aecee9dbe005017234a6a7f2838ce4dbeac404aa.png[/img]

[h3][b]Greetings, Humans!
Today we’ve got some hot news straight from the creative forge of our team[/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2642840/Humans_are_not_that_against_Lizardwomen_2/

🫂 Not only are the main heroes returning, but also your favorite side characters! Get ready to reunite with those who have already won your hearts. And not just reunite - some of them will get even more screen time… if you know what we mean 😉

[h3][b]🐾 The purrfect Cat will appear in Part 2 in an especially spicy scene 🌶[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787231/ed9ae2f8e244714a37941a00318dda91df169c0a.png[/img]
[h3][b]💀 Koshchey won’t be left behind either! As a bonus, we’ve prepared an atmospheric background straight from his gloomy palace.[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45161327/f1adc9dba0f517e6f93a056a98d64ae62c48252e.png[/img]

[b]🔜 Part 2 is getting closer! [/b]We’re refining, polishing, and perfecting every dialogue, every scene, and every level. We want the game to be exactly what you’re waiting for - bigger, hotter, and even more exciting.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2642840/Humans_are_not_that_against_Lizardwomen_2/

🙏 Support us: add Part 2 to your Steam wishlist, subscribe for updates, and don’t forget to follow us on social media - lots of exciting things are coming!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787231/b5373bc907be48f0523f824b8a95971a9a9af497.png[/img]

notes.title: Devlog 2.7
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45161327/df7224e22f2710276d506614ef5c79493f6d7582.png[/img]
[h3][b]Greetings, Humans![/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2642840
[h3][b]Here’s a quick update on what the team (and the lizards) are working on right now:[/b][/h3]

[b]✍️ The script for Part 2 is fully complete.[/b] Dialogues and scenes are written, and every character has found their lines. Now the story is waiting for its technical and visual embodiment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45161327/1bfbdd0a993c97b0243ad7b663343703f9acee2f.png[/img]

[b]🎨 Art is in progress. [/b]Sketches are turning into full scenes, characters are gaining emotions and colors. A blush on both human and lizard cheeks, drops of sweat… we’re paying attention to every detail to make the final result worth the wait 🫡🔥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45161327/eb9c5850867b103860803adcb8d4f4a5e096314c.png[/img]

We’re steadily bringing the game closer to the vision we want, and it’s only thanks to your support that we can keep moving forward. [b]Thank you for waiting, commenting, and inspiring us ❤️[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45161327/b5373bc907be48f0523f824b8a95971a9a9af497.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2642840

notes.title: Devlog 2.5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45161327/bc05f6ce6e589db24baed00f028924ae0e3fb2a3.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Greetings, Humans![/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2642840/Humans_are_not_that_against_Lizardwomen_2/
[h3][b]We bring good news for our friends abroad and fans of foreign languages😏[/b][/h3]

So that every brave warrior and fair maiden - even from distant lands - can understand our Part 2 DEMO, we’ve been working hard on localization into [b]7 languages[/b]. And Perun is our witness - this is only the beginning!

[b][h3]You can now play the demo in:[/h3][/b]
💗Russian
💗English
💗French
💗Italian
💗Spanish
💗Portuguese
💗German

And we’re not stopping there! What language do you think Humans are not that against Lizardwomen should speak next? Let us know in the comments ✍️

Thank you for being with us - your support is like a cup of warm mead on a cold night: comforting and invigorating! Stay tuned for more ❤️

notes.title: Shana - Priestess of Tona: ADD TO YOUR WISHLIST! WE ARE PUBLISHING A NEW GAME 💖
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44721122/0aa60e9ecf014bc7cf25b8cf132db87d12dacca4.png[/img]

[i]Hi! 🏝️🍹⛱️[/i]
We have great news today! We chatted with the cool guys from [b]Lustration Team[/b] for a while. They are known for their game Lyndaria: Lust Adventure, and now they are developing a spin-off game about the priestess Shana ❤️ So, the news is that we decided to publish their game about Shana, because it looks interesting, and the developers themselves are good people. So meet Shana - [u][b]Priestess of Tona[/b][/u] 🤩

[b][h1]We will be glad if you add the game to your wishlist 🙏 👉👈[/h1][/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3757060

[h1][b]➡️ WHAT THE GAME IS ABOUT?[/b][/h1]
[b]Shana - Priestess of Tona[/b] - is an adult roguelike autobattler where you’re bound to enjoy your victories over your enemies… Or you’re doomed to be enjoyed by them if you lose 💋 Hot dungeon bosses scenes, different girls selection and more...

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44721122/7ad1a588c09aff306daf52c57a8cfaa0092fe543.png[/img]

[h1][b]➡️ WHAT’S IN THE GAME:[/b][/h1]
👑 Three difficulty levels, for those who like it easier or more hardcore
🙋🏻‍♀️ The ability to choose your battle companions and change your play style
🤤 32 juicy animations of “dominating” bosses (H-scenes)
👹 More than 50 types of monsters
⚙️ Inventory system, store, skills and much more!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44721122/253228685892a6c762c5f8226648440d3fbcc21b.jpg[/img]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44721122/0f162dabc7c71423805d6aae7f1aacf37235a993.jpg[/img]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44721122/34da53989055fe185735e56744ec0f93b835bde2.png[/img]

[h1]The guys are trying very hard to do something unusual in our spicy genre, so they will be glad to receive any wishlists from you! I urge you to support the guys in this eternal struggle of collecting wishlists by indie developers 👇👇👇[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3757060

[i][b]We would also be glad if you add our other games to your wishlist::[/b][/i]
